Fix multi-word search: use munge_search_term from plone.base

Replace local munge_search_term and helpers with imports from
plone.base.utils. Add zope.deferredimport deprecation shims for the
old import paths (will be removed in Plone 7).

Update test expectations for the fixed wildcard behavior where all
unquoted terms get wildcard prefix matching.

Fixes #4205
